title: "SCOP 函数学习入口"
description: "按任务查找 SCOP 0.8.9 runners、plotters、required inputs、output locations、教程与本地验证命令。"
---

本页是学习 gateway，不替代 upstream help。它将 research task 映射到 **runner**、**SCOP-native plotter**、object contract 和详细教程。Exact arguments 以本机 installed package help 为准。

::: {.learning-objectives}
## 学习目标

你将学会：

1. 按 biological task 而不是函数名查找 SCOP；
2. 配对 runner 与 SCOP plotter；
3. 确认 assay/layer、metadata、reduction、backend 或 reference；
4. 复制代码前本地验证 exports/signatures；
5. 将 function call 记录为 reproducible evidence。
:::

## 1 · Runtime 与本地验证

Published runtime 的 SCOP 0.8.9 有 **314 exports**。

```r
library(scop)
packageVersion("scop")
exports <- sort(getNamespaceExports("scop"))
length(exports)
"Harmony_integrate" %in% exports
args(scop::Harmony_integrate)
help("Harmony_integrate", package = "scop")
```

```r
verify_scop_function <- function(name) {
  stopifnot(name %in% getNamespaceExports("scop"))
  list(
    package_version = as.character(packageVersion("scop")),
    name = name,
    signature = args(getExportedValue("scop", name))
  )
}
verify_scop_function("RunDimsEstimate")
```

若本机 signature 不同，按 local help 修改并记录 version difference，不能从函数名猜 wrapper。

::: {.input-contract}
**函数调用合同**

记录 input checkpoint、assay/layer、reduction/dimensions、group/sample fields、reference/database/model、backend、完整 arguments、seed、result location、plotter、output table 和 allowed claim。
:::

## 2 · Input/data access/conversion

| 任务 | SCOP | 输入 | 输出/下一步 | 教程 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| named collection | `LoadScopDataset()` | dataset/collection/cache | object/path；审计 source/hash | [输入](input-formats.qmd) |
| H5 + metadata | `FetchH5()` | files + assay/layer | Seurat；证明 metadata join | [输入](input-formats.qmd) |
| H5AD | `h5ad_to_srt()` | H5AD + `zellkonverter` | 验证 `.X`/layers/obs/var | [输入](input-formats.qmd#h5ad-and-loom) |
| Loom | `loom_to_srt()` | Loom + `loomR` | 验证 spliced/unspliced | [输入](input-formats.qmd#h5ad-and-loom) |

10x H5/三件套先使用 Seurat readers，这是有意设计；object contract 通过后进入 SCOP。

## 3 · Cell/spot QC

| 任务 | Runner | Plotter | 合同 | 教程 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cell QC | `RunCellQC()` | `FeatureStatPlot()` | raw counts、species-aware、per-sample | [单样本](single-cell-case.qmd) |
| doublet path | `db_scDblFinder()` | SCOP QC plots | per-library raw counts | [单样本](single-cell-case.qmd) |
| general doublet | `RunDoubletCalling()` | relevant SCOP plot | method/rate/counts | [单样本](single-cell-case.qmd) |
| contamination | `RunDecontX()` | before/after SCOP plot | original counts + background contract | [单样本](single-cell-case.qmd) |
| spot QC | `RunSpotQC()` | `FeatureStatPlot()` / spatial plot | Spatial assay + coordinate/image | [空间](spatial-case.qmd) |

函数返回成功不替你选择 threshold。保存 before/after distributions 与 retained counts/sample。

## 4 · Construction/integration/dimensions/clustering

| 任务 | Function | 最低输入 | 验证 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harmony | `Harmony_integrate()` | technical `batch`、assay、normalization | mixing + biology preservation |
| CCA | `CCA_integrate()` | shared features/populations | anchors + preservation |
| RPCA | `RPCA_integrate()` | within-source PCA | conservative correction |
| scVI | `scVI_integrate()` | counts/sample/Python | env/version + latent diagnostics |
| dimensions | `RunDimsEstimate()` | valid reduction | `DimsEstimatePlot()` |
| cluster stability | `ClusterTreePlot()` | multiple resolution columns | transitions across grid |
| embedding | `CellDimPlot()` | reduction/group fields | SCOP-native display |

默认 order：`db_scDblFinder()` → `JoinLayers()` → multi-resolution / `ClusterTreePlot()` → 有依据时 SCT+integration → `RunDimsEstimate()`。

| Method | 适合 | 前提 | 停止条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harmony | shared states + technical source | batch field | biology erased/confounding |
| CCA | correlated shared structure | common features | unlike populations anchored |
| RPCA | large related datasets | within-PCA | no shared populations |
| scVI | nonlinear latent model | Python/counts | backend instability/poor preservation |

Executable Harmony 参数见[多样本](multi-sample.qmd)。

## 5 · Markers 与 annotation

| 任务 | Runner | Plot/evidence | 必须审核 |
|---|---|---|---|
| cluster markers | `FindMarkers()` / `FindAllMarkers()` | `GroupHeatmap()` 等 SCOP expression plot | positive/negative programmes |
| CellTypist | `RunCellTypist()` | labels/confidence + marker/embedding | vocabulary/tissue/unknown |
| SingleR | `RunSingleR()` | prediction/pruning + markers | suitable reference/packages |
| RNA/ATAC transfer | `RunLabelTransfer()` | prediction/evaluation | assay class/reference/gene activity |

Classifier confidence 不等于 truth。分开保存 candidate、score、final、uncertainty、review note。详见[注释](annotation.qmd)。

## 6 · DEG/enrichment/composition

| 问题 | Runner | Plotter | Statistical unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 展示 valid DEG | external/SCOP table | `VolcanoPlot()` | 继承 DEG model |
| over-representation | `RunEnrichment()` | `EnrichmentPlot()` | 继承 list/design |
| ranked enrichment | `RunGSEA()` | `GSEAPlot()` | 继承 ranking/design |
| proportions | `RunPropeller()` | `ProportionTestPlot()` path | biological sample |
| general proportion | `RunProportionTest()` | `ProportionTestPlot()` | inferential 时是 sample |

Plotter 不能修复 pseudo-replication。Condition contrast 前先建立 sample-level design。详见[高级](advanced.qmd)。

## 7 · Trajectory/dynamics

| 目的 | Runner | Plotter | 前提 |
|---|---|---|---|
| connectivity/pseudotime | `RunPAGA()` | `PAGAPlot()` | group/reduction/root；可选 spliced |
| potential | `RunCytoTRACE()` | `CytoTRACEPlot()` | gene coverage |
| lineages | `RunSlingshot()` | returned trajectory | group/reduction/start/end |
| probabilistic | `RunPalantir()` | `PalantirTrajectoryPlot()` | backend/start |
| Monocle | `RunMonocle2/3()` | method-specific | compatible counts/root |
| velocity | `RunSecActVelocity()` | `VelocityPlot()` | aligned spliced/unspliced |

Audited version **没有** `RunVelocity()`。Ordering/arrow field 不是 lineage proof。

## 8 · Communication/regulation/metabolism

| 任务 | Runner | Plotters | 资源/边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| cell communication | `RunCellChat()` | `CCCNetworkPlot()` / `CCCHeatmap()` / `CCCStatPlot()` | species DB/group sizes；hypothesis |
| spatial communication | `RunSpatialCellChat()` | `SpatialCellChatPlot()` | coordinates/technology |
| regulons | `RunSCENIC()` | `SCENICPlot()` | motif DB/genome/backend |
| SCENIC+ | `RunSCENICPlus()` | stored result/SCOP display | multiome/resources |
| metabolism | `RunMetabolism()` | `MetabolismPlot()` | pathway DB/version/coverage |

结果常存 assay、metadata 或 `srt@tools`；查看 returned object/help，并在适用时给 plotter 传同一个 `tool_name`。

## 9 · Malignancy/phenotype

| 任务 | Runner | Plotter | 合同 |
|---|---|---|---|
| expression CNV | `RunCNV()` | `CNVPlot()` | genome/method/normal reference/sample |
| bulk phenotype cells | `RunScissor()` | `ScissorPlot()` | aligned bulk/features/phenotype/family |

两者都不建立 clinical malignancy 或 causality，需要 orthogonal validation。

## 10 · Spatial transcriptomics

| 任务 | Runner | Plotter | 输入 |
|---|---|---|---|
| spot/domain | — | `SpatialSpotPlot()` | image/coordinates |
| variable features | `RunSpatialVariableFeatures()` | `SpatialVariableFeaturePlot()` | assay/coords/method |
| graph | `RunSpatialNetwork()` | `SpatialNetworkPlot()` | k/radius/graph name |
| neighbourhood | `RunSpatialNeighborhood()` | `SpatialNeighborhoodPlot()` | groups/coords/tool name |
| deconvolution | `RunRCTD()` | SCOP spatial display | compatible reference + `spacexr` |
| multi-slice | `RunSpatialIntegration()` | `SpatialSpotPlot()` + diagnostics | sample/slice + backend |
| communication | `RunSpatialCellChat()` | `SpatialCellChatPlot()` | group/species/technology/coords |

Spot、domain、deconvolution 与 cell-resolved claims 不同，必须说明实际返回层级。

## 11 · Plotter provenance pattern

```r
plot_record <- list(
  plot_function = "scop::CellDimPlot",
  dataset = "panc8_sub",
  source_checkpoint = "artifacts/checkpoints/cross-source.rds",
  arguments = list(
    group.by = "dataset",
    reduction = "HarmonyUMAP2D",
    show_stat = FALSE
  ),
  allowed_claim = "technical-source mixing diagnostic"
)
```

Graphics device 可以保存/组合 SCOP 返回图，但不能用 unrelated manual ggplot 替换 analysis layer 后仍写 SCOP caption。

::: {.checkpoint}
**Reference 检查点**

运行新函数前验证 exported status、`args()`/help、prerequisites/backends、result storage、正确 SCOP plotter 与 interpretation boundary。
:::

::: {.exercise}
## 练习

选择一个 biological question，填写 runner、plotter、input checkpoint、assay/layer、group/sample fields、backend/reference、output location/table、validation、failure status，以及不能证明的一句话。
:::

完整逐函数 arguments 请看 [upstream SCOP reference](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/)。本站补充 workflow、evidence 和 claim context。

::: {.boundary}
Function availability 只证明 API 存在，不证明适用。只有 input、design、backend、validation、claim contract 全部通过，函数才应进入分析。
:::
